about: Reference labels for 19 DEV dialogs, written by the team from the checklist PDF. They are our reading of the checklist, not the organizers' ground truth. Use them to compare models and prompt changes, and correct them when the team disagrees.

labels.notes: c7: goodbye only, no summary or offer of further help.
Identity confirmed by a system message before the account check.
Account restriction disclosed without verification. The reason was never answered; the client had to ask again.
Guessed 'reinstall the app' instead of clarifying; resolved in the end.

Dismissive guess without asking which bond, then 'I don't know' and closed the chat. Revised c3 na->no: the client asked why HIS orders are rejected, an account-specific request like p1-ru-009 and p1-en-014, and no identification happened. c8 stays no: the operator guessed, no account data was disclosed.
Asked the client to send money to the operator's card. c6 judges clarity only.
Client left before stating a request.

'Вы вообще читать умеете?' is an insult; the answer itself was correct. Revised c6 7->4: the first reply had no answer, so the client had to ask again ('Не понимаю, на какой сайт перейти'), which is level 4. Rudeness is scored in c5 and c8, not c6.
c7: a good wish without a summary or offer of further help.
Verified before the payment check; clarified currency and time.
'Сәлем.' without introduction; asked again for the site the client had already named.
Connection to the client was lost right after the answer.
Offered paid private advice by personal phone; closed the chat without a goodbye.
Model case: empathy, verification, clarification, summary.
Connection lost after the client's thanks.
'We can skip that': account data disclosed without verification; the client's questions ignored.
No greeting; wrong first instruction made the client ask again.
Call. The first operator line greets and gives a name despite recognition errors. The client ended the call.
